_: Every instruction the studio gives an AI model, for the read-only prompt page in system management. Each entry points at where the wording lives; studio/core/prompt_book.py reads it fresh, so this file never holds a copy. tests/core/test_prompt_book.py fails when a prompt file or a named prompt line exists that no entry lists. Developer-only tools (voice lab, the first-hour script, evalkit's benchmark runner) are left out on purpose.
